# Biodalliance 0.13

An unmodified copy of the Biodalliance genome browser release, so the front end never loads it from a third-party site.

- Source: https://www.biodalliance.org/release-0.13/ (code: https://github.com/dasmoth/dalliance)
- Version: 0.13, downloaded October 20, 2026, files unchanged
- Served by the web app at `<base>biodalliance/` and loaded only when the API is on

| Files | License |
| --- | --- |
| `dalliance-compiled.js`, `worker-all.js`, `css/dalliance-scoped.css`, `img/` | BSD 2-Clause, Thomas Down and others: `LICENSE` |
| `css/bootstrap-scoped.css` (a scoped Bootstrap 2 build) | Apache 2.0: `licenses/bootstrap-LICENSE` |
| `css/font-awesome.min.css` | MIT, Font Awesome 4.0.3: `licenses/font-awesome-NOTICE.md` |
| `fonts/` | SIL Open Font License 1.1, Font Awesome 4.0.3: `licenses/font-awesome-NOTICE.md` |

Don't edit these files. To upgrade, replace the folder with a newer release and update this note.
